claims.question: What is the default value of Open WebUI's RAG_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE?
What is the default value of RAG_EMBEDDING_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS in Open WebUI?
Does Open WebUI auto-append a path to RAG_EXTERNAL_RERANKER_URL?
claims.skill_answer: No — that URL is used exactly; only the embed base URL gets /embeddings appended

claims.question: What request body shape does Open WebUI's ExternalReranker send?
claims.skill_answer: {model, query, documents, top_n} — Cohere shape, top_n = len(documents)

claims.question: What response shape must a reranker return for Open WebUI to use it?
What happens in Open WebUI retrieval when the external reranker returns non-2xx?
claims.skill_answer: predict() returns None; retrieval silently falls back to un-reranked hybrid order

claims.question: Why can't Text Embeddings Inference's native /rerank be wired directly to Open WebUI?
claims.skill_answer: TEI uses {query, texts} → [{index, score}]; incompatible, returns 422. Needs LiteLLM translation

claims.question: What does setting RAG_EMBEDDING_PREFIX_FIELD_NAME do?
claims.skill_answer: Switches prefixes from string-prepended to a separate JSON field (Ollama-only); leave unset for openai engine

claims.question: Which common embedding model requires no query/document prefixes?
claims.skill_answer: BGE-M3 — it is symmetric; e5, EmbeddingGemma, Qwen3-Embedding are asymmetric

claims.question: In Open WebUI 0.11.0, why does GET /api/v1/knowledge/{id} no longer show extracted file text?
claims.skill_answer: get_file_metadatas_by_id became column-only SELECT excluding File.data; fetch GET /api/v1/files/{id} instead
